mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts and retail sales above 0.5% signal robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase by >0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both rise >0.5% MoM, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production in the early-cycle expansion phase indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential demand, which correlates with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals heightened inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong employment growth (PAYEMS >50k MoM) and declining unemployment (UNRATE fall >0.1pp MoM) indicate a rapidly improving labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >50k and UNRATE falls by >0.1pp in the last month
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises >50k MoM and UNRATE falls >0.1pp MoM, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods.
